an8.12:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an8.12:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā Licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti. 2.
an8.12:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Sīho senāpati Nigaṇṭhasāvako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
an8.12:2.2: Atha kho Sīhassa senāpatissa etad ahosi
an8.12:2.3: ‘nissaṃsayaṃ kho so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhavissati, tathā h' ime sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā Licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti;
an8.12:2.4: yan nūnāhaṃ taṃ Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan' ti. 3.
an8.12:2.5: Atha kho Sīho senāpati yena Nigaṇṭho Nāṭaputto ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Nigaṇṭhaṃ Nāṭaputtaṃ etad avoca
an8.12:2.6: ‘icchām' ahaṃ bhante samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitun' ti.
an8.12:3.1: ‘Kiṃ pana tvaṃ Sīha kiriyavādo samāno akiriyavādaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissasi?
an8.12:3.2: Samaṇo hi Sīha Gotamo akiriyavādo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī' ti.
an8.12:3.3: Atha kho Sīhassa senāpatissa yo ahosi gamiyābhisaṅkhāro Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya, so paṭippassambhi. 4.
an8.12:4.1: Dutiyam pi kho sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā Licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
an8.12:4.2: Dutiyaṃ pi kho Sīhassa senāpatissa etad ahosi
an8.12:4.3: ‘nissaṃsayaṃ kho so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhavissati, tathā h' ime sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā Licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti;
an8.12:4.4: yan nūnāhaṃ taṃ Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan' ti.
an8.12:4.5: Atha kho Sīho senāpati yena Nigaṇṭho Nāṭaputto ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Nigaṇṭhaṃ Nāṭaputtaṃ etad avoca
an8.12:4.6: ‘icchām' ahaṃ bhante samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitun' ti.
an8.12:5.1: ‘Kiṃ pana tvaṃ Sīha kiriyavādo samāno akiriyavādaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissasi?
an8.12:5.2: Samaṇo hi Sīha Gotamo akiriyavādo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī' ti.
an8.12:5.3: Dutiyam pi kho Sīhassa senāpatissa yo ahosi gamiyābhisaṅkhāro Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya, so paṭippassambhi. 5.
an8.12:6.1: Tatiyam pi kho sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā Licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti.
an8.12:6.2: Tatiyam pi kho Sīhassa senāpatissa etad ahosi
an8.12:6.3: ‘nissaṃsayaṃ kho so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhavissati, tathā h' ime sambahulā abhiññātā abhiññātā Licchavī santhāgāre sannisinnā sannipatitā anekapariyāyena buddhassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, dhammassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti, saṅghassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti;
an8.12:6.4: kiṃ hi 'me karissanti Nigaṇṭhā apalokitā vā anapalokitā vā;
an8.12:6.5: yan nūnāhaṃ anapaloketvā 'va Nigaṇṭhe taṃ Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan' ti.
an8.12:7.1: Atha kho Sīho senāpati pañcamattehi rathasatehi divādivassa Vesāliyā niyyāsi Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
an8.12:7.2: Yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yanā paccorohitvā pattiko 'va ārāmaṃ pāvisi.
an8.12:7.3: Atha kho Sīho senāpati yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Sīho senāpati Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.12:8.2: akiriyavādo samaṇo Gotamo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:8.3: Ye te bhante evam āhaṃsu: akiriyavādo samaṇo Gotamo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti, kacci te bhante Bhagavato vuttavādino na ca Bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti dhammassa cānudhammaṃ vyākaronti na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati.
an8.12:8.4: Anabbhakkhātukāmā hi mayaṃ bhante Bhagavantan' ti. 6.
an8.12:9.1: Atthi Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:9.2: akiriyavādo samaṇo Gotamo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:10.1: Atthi Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:10.2: kiriyavādo samaṇo Gotamo kiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:11.1: Atthi Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:11.2: ucchedavādo samaṇo Gotamo ucchedāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:12.1: Atthi Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:12.2: jegucchī samaṇo Gotamo jegucchitāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:13.1: Atthi Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:13.2: venayiko samano Gotamo vinayāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:14.1: Atthi Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:14.2: tapassī samaṇo Gotamo tapassitāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:15.1: Atthi Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an8.12:15.2: apagabbho samaṇo Gotamo apagabbhatāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:16.1: Atthi Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:16.2: assattho samaṇo Gotamo assāsāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti. 7.
an8.12:17.1: Katamo ca Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:17.2: akiriyavādo samaṇo Gotamo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti? Ahaṃ
an8.12:17.3: hi Sīha akiriyaṃ vadāmi kāyaduccaritassa vacīduccaritassa manoduccaritassa,
an8.12:17.4: anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ akiriyaṃ vadāmi.
an8.12:17.5: Ayaṃ kho Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:17.6: akiriyavādo samaṇo Gotamo akiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:18.1: Katamo ca Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:18.2: kiriyavādo samaṇo Gotamo kiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti? Ahaṃ
an8.12:18.3: hi Sīha kiriyaṃ vadāmi kāyasucaritassa vacīsucaritassa manosucaritassa,
an8.12:18.5: Ayaṃ kho Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:18.6: kiriyavādo samaṇo Gotamo kiriyāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:19.1: Katamo ca Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:19.2: ucchedavādo samaṇo Gotamo ucchedāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti? Ahaṃ
an8.12:19.3: hi Sīha ucchedaṃ vadāmi rāgassa dosassa mohassa,
an8.12:19.4: anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ucchedaṃ vadāmi.
an8.12:19.5: Ayaṃ kho Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:19.6: ucchedavādo samaṇo Gotamo ucchedāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:20.1: Katamo ca Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:20.2: jegucchī samaṇo Gotamo jegucchitāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti? Ahaṃ
an8.12:20.3: hi Sīha jigucchāmi kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena,
an8.12:20.4: jigucchāmi anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
an8.12:20.5: Ayaṃ kho Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:20.6: jegucchī samaṇo Gotamo jegucchitāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:21.1: Katamo ca Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:21.2: venayiko samaṇo Gotamo vinayāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti? Ahaṃ
an8.12:21.3: hi Sīha vinayāya dhammaṃ desemi rāgassa dosassa mohassa,
an8.12:21.4: anekavihitānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vinayāya dhammaṃ desemi.
an8.12:21.5: Ayaṃ kho Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:21.6: venayiko samaṇo Gotamo vinayāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:22.1: Katamo ca Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:22.2: tapassī samaṇo Gotamo tapassitāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti?
an8.12:22.3: Tapanīyāhaṃ Sīha pāpake akusale dhamme vadāmi: kāyaduccaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ.
an8.12:22.4: Yassa kho Sīha tapanīyā pāpakā akusalā dhammā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā, tam ahaṃ tapassī ti vadāmi.
an8.12:22.5: Tathāgatassa kho Sīha tapanīyā pāpakā akusalā dhammā pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an8.12:22.6: Ayaṃ kho Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:22.7: tapassī samaṇo Gotamo tapassitāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:23.1: Katamo ca Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:23.2: apagabbho samaṇo Gotamo apagabbhatāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti?
an8.12:23.3: Yassa kho Sīha āyatiṃ gabbhaseyyā punabbhavābhinibbatti pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā, tam ahaṃ apagabbho ti vadāmi.
an8.12:23.4: Tathāgatassa kho Sīha āyatiṃ gabbhaseyyā punabbhavābhinibbatti pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
an8.12:23.5: Ayaṃ kho Sīha pariyāyo yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:23.6: apagabbho samaṇo Gotamo apagabbhatāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti.
an8.12:24.1: Katamo ca Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:24.2: assattho samaṇo Gotamo assāsāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti? Ahaṃ
an8.12:24.3: hi Sīha assattho paramena assāsena assāsāya dhammaṃ desemi, tena ca sāvake vinemi.
an8.12:24.4: Ayaṃ kho Sīha pariyāyo, yena maṃ pariyāyena sammā vadamāno vadeyya:
an8.12:24.5: assattho samaṇo Gotamo assāsāya dhammaṃ deseti, tena ca sāvake vinetī ti. 8.
an8.12:25.1: Evaṃ vutte Sīho senāpati Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.12:25.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante Bhagavā dhāretu ajja-t-agge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan' ti.
an8.12:26.1: ‘Anuviccakāraṃ kho Sīha karohi, anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotī' ti.
an8.12:26.2: ‘Iminā p' ahaṃ bhante Bhagavato bhiyyosomattāya attamano abhiraddho, yaṃ maṃ Bhagavā evam āha: anuviccakāraṃ kho Sīha karohi, anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotī ti. Maṃ
an8.12:26.3: hi bhante aññatitthiyā sāvakaṃ labhitvā kevalakappaṃ Vesāliṃ paṭākaṃ parihareyyuṃ:
an8.12:26.4: Sīho amhākaṃ senāpati sāvakattaṃ upagato ti.
an8.12:26.5: Atha ca pana maṃ Bhagavā evam āha: anuviccakāraṃ kho Sīha karohi, anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotī ti.
an8.12:26.6: Esāhaṃ bhante dutiyam pi Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṅghañ ca,
an8.12:26.7: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante Bhagavā dhāretu ajja-t-agge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan' ti.
an8.12:27.1: ‘Dīgharattaṃ kho te Sīha Nigaṇṭhanaṃ opānabhūtaṃ kulaṃ, yena nesaṃ upagatānaṃ piṇḍakaṃ dātabbaṃ maññeyyāsī' ti.
an8.12:27.2: ‘Iminā p' ahaṃ bhante Bhagavato bhiyyosomattāya attamano abhiraddho, yaṃ maṃ Bhagavā evam āha:
an8.12:27.3: dīgharattaṃ kho te Sīha Nigaṇṭhānaṃ opānabhūtaṃ kulaṃ, yena nesaṃ upagatānaṃ piṇḍakaṃ dātabbaṃ maññeyyāsī ti.
an8.12:27.6: "mayham eva dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, na aññesaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ;
an8.12:27.7: mayham eva sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, na aññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ; mayham eva dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, na aññesaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ;
an8.12:27.8: mayham eva sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, na aññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalan" ti.
an8.12:27.9: Atha ca pana maṃ Bhagavā Nigaṇṭhesu pi dāne samādapeti,
an8.12:27.10: api ca bhante mayam ettha kālaṃ jānissāma.
an8.12:27.11: Esāhaṃ bhante tatiyam pi Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṅghañ ca,
an8.12:27.12: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante Bhagavā dhāretu ajja-t-agge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan' ti. 9.
an8.12:28.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Sīhassa senāpatissa anupubbikathaṃ kathesi, seyyathīdaṃ
an8.12:28.2: dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
an8.12:28.3: Yadā Bhagavā aññāsi Sīhaṃ senāpatiṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinivaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā, taṃ pakāsesi:
an8.12:28.5: Seyyathā pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakālakaṃ samma-d-eva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya,
an8.12:28.6: evam eva Sīhassa senāpatissa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi
an8.12:28.7: ‘yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ, sabban taṃ nirodhadhamman' ti. 10.
an8.12:29.1: Atha kho Sīho senāpati diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparapaccayo Satthu sāsane Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.12:29.2: ‘adhivāsetu me bhante Bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā' ti.
an8.12:29.4: Atha kho Sīho senāpati Bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an8.12:30.1: Atha kho Sīho senāpati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi
an8.12:30.2: ‘gaccha tvaṃ ambho purisa pavattamaṃsaṃ jānāhī' ti.
an8.12:30.3: Atha kho Sīho senāpati tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā Bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi
an8.12:30.4: ‘kālo bhante, Sīhassa senāpatissa nivesane niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan' ti. 11.
an8.12:31.1: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Sīhassa senāpatissa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
an8.12:31.2: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā Nigaṇṭhā Vesāliyaṃ rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ bāhā paggayha kandanti
an8.12:31.3: ‘ajja Sīheno senāpatinā thullaṃ pasuṃ vadhitvā samaṇassa Gotamassa bhattaṃ kataṃ,
an8.12:31.4: taṃ samaṇo Gotamo jānaṃ uddissa kataṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭicca kamman' ti.
an8.12:32.1: Atha kho aññataro puriso yena Sīho senāpati ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Sīhassa senāpatissa upakaṇṇake ārocesi
an8.12:32.3: ete sambahulā Nigaṇṭhā Vesāliyaṃ rathiyāya rathiyaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ bāhā paggayhakandanti:
an8.12:32.4: ajja Sīhena senāpatinā thullaṃ pasuṃ vadhitvā samaṇassa Gotamassa bhattaṃ kataṃ,
an8.12:32.5: taṃ samaṇo Gotamo jānaṃ uddissa kataṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭicca kamman' ti.
an8.12:32.6: ‘Alaṃ ayyo, dīgharattaṃ hi te āyasmanto avaṇṇakāmā buddhassa avaṇṇakāmā dhammassa avaṇṇakāmā saṅghassa,
an8.12:32.7: na ca pana te āyasmanto jīranti taṃ Bhagavantaṃ asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhantā,
an8.12:32.8: na ca mayaṃ jīvitahetu pi sañcicca pāṇaṃ jīvitā voropeyyāmā' ti. 12.
an8.12:33.1: Atha kho Sīho senāpati buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādaniyena bhojaniyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
an8.12:33.2: Atha kho Sīho senāpati Bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an8.12:33.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Sīhaṃ senāpatiṃ Bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmī
